_comment: Timing units for the common combinational modules (rtl/common/), for tools/check-ngd.py: one module at one parameterisation each. ccv_common_csa is an inner helper, timed in its parents; held alone, NGD-6's 16 caps it, so its unit is 6 operands (3 compressor levels and the add, TI's response OI-76); ooe_freelist's instance times the 16-group form. The SECDED helpers (ccv_common_secded_enc, _syn, _fix; DA rulings TI-474 to TI-476) are inner helpers too, each at K = 128, the widest SRAM word (MACRO-1), within the 16 alone. ccv_common_wayfold (MA-30, AR 405) is an inner helper as well, at K = 4, W = 32.
